text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Interior Ministry wants to revive its weapons seizing effort.
- Kuwait, Lebanon sign 20-year agreement to promote and protect investments.
- Minister of Finance Nasser al-Rodhan says Iran's market promising.

- Arab parliamentarians urge Iraq to release POWs. Kuwait says Iraq still holds about 600 Kuwaitis and other third world countries nationals since its 1990-91 occupation of the Gulf state. Baghdad denies.
- Kuwait to take part in Gulf Arab trade promotion conference.
- Minister of Commerce and Industry Jassem al-Mudaf says oil makes 90 percent of Kuwait's exports and 60 percent of state earnings.
- Share price index rises 17.1 points to 2,320.2.
